entries.summary: Added a teleport-to-leader button to the floating widget for followers.
Road-following routes now retry across more servers when one is slow or unavailable.
Followers now automatically rejoin their group after a device restart.
Fixed follower and leader mode not resuming until the Group Sync screen was opened.
Improved reliability of group sync and QR discovery on mobile hotspot networks.
Spoofing now keeps working reliably after the screen locks.
Fixed a bug where adding the next walk point could corrupt the current walk or route on the floating map.
Fixed the widget button occasionally not responding to a tap on noisy touchscreens.
Fixed an incorrect Slow Walk speed value.
